title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
statement:
Given two integer arrays `preorder` and `inorder` where `preorder` is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and `inorder` is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.

The output should be the Level-order traversal array of the constructed tree.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing the `preorder` array.
Line 3: N space-separated integers representing the `inorder` array.
outputFormat: Space-separated strings mapping the level-order traversal of the built tree.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 3000
-3000 <= preorder[i], inorder[i] <= 3000
preorder and inorder consist of unique values.
Each value of inorder also appears in preorder.
inorder is guaranteed to be the inorder traversal of the tree.

examples.explanation: Root is 3. Left subtree preorder is [9], inorder [9]. Right subtree preorder [20, 15, 7], inorder [15, 20, 7].

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
preorder = list(map(int, input().split()))
inorder = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Implement tree construction

testCases.expectedOutput: 10 null 20 null null null 30 null null null null null null null 40
